messages:
sam: heads up — just noticed spike of 403s from metrics-service, started ~2432109800. :eyes:
sec-bot: [Alert] 403 rate increased 5.3% on metrics-service since 12:30Z, linked to perm-deny code path
julia: any deploys? rollback?
sam: we rolled RBAC schema v3 migration ~10m ago (rolebinding TTL format changed + new binding source). suspecting TTL truncation / missing grantee_kid.
mike: looking at audit logs — missing grant events for service-account:metrics-reader in the migration window.
anya: KMS rotation happened ~9m ago. KMS logs show key KID-7 rotated, some decrypt errors around 2432109820. running query: `SELECT count(*) FROM audit.events WHERE action='grant' AND target='metrics-reader' AND ts > 2432109600`
sam: query result: 0 — no grants recorded after migration started.
mike: that matches. hypothesis: migration wrote bindings but left `grantee_kid` empty when KMS returned a transient error. those bindings expire immediately because TTL parser treats empty as "0".
julia: can we hotfix with a targeted backfill to restore previous binding payloads for the affected service accounts?
anya: two options: 1) re-run grant flow using current KID (may not match original material), 2) patch binding rows to restore legacy payload format and TTL semantics so they don't expire. option 2 is lower blast radius.
oncall: I'll run a canary rollback to pre-migration config on shard-a, invalidate local caches, and watch 403s.
sec-bot: Incident INC-2026-043 created, severity=P2 — assignee=oncall — links: https://incidents/redwood/INC-2026-043
sam: do a dry-run backfill first for 100 rows: 
```
-- backfill dry-run snippet
UPDATE role_bindings SET binding_payload = payload_old WHERE source='rbac_migration_v3' AND shard='a' LIMIT 100;
```
mike: tailing DB and KMS logs now. command I use: `gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName=\"Decrypt\"" --limit 50` to see decrypt failures.
julia: toggle feature-flag `rbac_v3_enabled=false` in prod-config to stop further writes from the new migrator, then redeploy the migrator with a fix. propagate flag via config service.
oncall: canary rollback applied to shard-a — 403s down to baseline within 2 min. rolling to shards b/c in 5m.
anya: postmortem action items: 1) migrator must validate KMS decrypt success before committing binding rows, 2) atomic re-encryption plan when KMS rotates (detect KID mismatch and pause), 3) add audit assertion that grant events exist for every binding written.
sam: I'll open the runbook PR and assign owners: migrator fix -> mike, KMS gating -> anya, audit assertion -> julia.
julia: also add monitoring alert for sudden drop in 'grant' events rate relative to binding writes.
oncall: updating incident channel with current status and ETA for full rollback across all shards.
sam: good catch everyone, keep updates in this thread. escalate if any P1 evidence. :thumbsup:
